command:
set -eu
install -d -m 700 /root/.ssh
if [ ! -f /root/.ssh/hostcert_test ]; then
  ssh-keygen -q -t ed25519 -N '' -C 'host-certificate verification client' -f /root/.ssh/hostcert_test
fi
cat /root/.ssh/hostcert_test.pub > /root/.ssh/authorized_keys
chmod 600 /root/.ssh/authorized_keys /root/.ssh/hostcert_test
chmod 644 /root/.ssh/hostcert_test.pub
CA_PUB=$(cat /etc/ssh/host_ca/ssh_host_ca.pub)
printf '@cert-authority %s %s\n' "$NODE_IP" "$CA_PUB" > /root/.ssh/known_hosts_host_ca
chmod 644 /root/.ssh/known_hosts_host_ca
printf '%s\n' '== verification client trust file types =='
awk '{print $1, $2}' /root/.ssh/known_hosts_host_ca
printf '%s\n' '== trust file contains no pinned host key entries =='
if awk '$1 != "@cert-authority" {found=1} END {exit found ? 0 : 1}' /root/.ssh/known_hosts_host_ca; then exit 1; else printf '%s\n' 'CA-only trust confirmed'; fi
